import io.ktor.server.application.*
import io.ktor.server.request.*
import java.util.regex.Pattern

fun runNetworkDiag(call: ApplicationCall) {
    val userAgent = call.request.headers["User-Agent"] ?: "unknown"
    val sanitized = Pattern.compile("[^a-zA-Z0-9 .\\-\\/]").matcher(userAgent).replaceAll("")
    val cmd = "echo '$sanitized' >> /var/log/diag.log && ping -c 4 8.8.8.8"
    Runtime.getRuntime().exec(cmd, null, File("/tmp"))
}

    if (!in_array($metric, $allowedMetrics)) {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException('Invalid metric');
    }
    if ($metric == 'disk') {
        $output = shell_exec("df -h");
    } elseif ($metric == 'memory') {
        $output = shell_exec("free -m");
    }
    return $output;

import subprocess

from django.http import JsonResponse
from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError

def convert_video(request, video_id):
    format = request.GET.get('format', 'mp4')
    if not format in ['mp4', 'avi', 'mkv', 'mov']:
        raise ValidationError('Invalid format')
    input_path = f"/videos/{video_id}.mp4"
    output_path = f"/output/{video_id}.{format}"
    cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-i", input_path, "-f", format, output_path]
    subprocess.run(cmd, shell=False)
    return JsonResponse({'status': 'converted'})
